record.name: Guyana
record.summary: No qualifying institute identified. Government accounts describe digitalisation and plans to develop IAST into an AI research and innovation hub.

partial.scope: Negative-status confidence, preserved query provenance, national/official-language search coverage and source-independence audit; this is not a full recheck of all record fields.

Reassessed negative confidence under the revised rule using saved research. The retrieved material does not sufficiently establish the national AI governance arrangements. No new search or full recheck.
Attempted preservation of cited source copies and checked saved-copy hashes; failures remain in source access notes. This source-evidence work is not a full factual recheck of the record.

Re-ran searches in English for a government-designated institute that evaluates advanced models, or a commitment, proposal or study naming one. No qualifying institute or commitment was identified; results described ministerial statements on AI in national development, a minister's IPU presentation urging parliamentary action on AI, and NDMA-led government digitisation. Kept low: the government's February 2026 report says only that AI is part of a long-term strategy, and the parliament's release returned HTTP 403. Partial check; the last full-check date is unchanged.

check.language_note: English is an official language or an official language of national administration; it is a practical national search language for this check. Other national or official languages were not exhaustively searched. Search source_ids identify registered source URLs matched in the retrieved result set, which may include irrelevant hits. An empty list means no registered source URL was matched, not that the web response was empty. The earlier audit used independent_source_ids for substantive corroboration; governance_source_ids, where present, identifies the selected primary governance evidence. Preserved result batches, using 1-based positions in check.searches: GY-search = searches 1, 2 (en, en). Each multi-query batch has only a combined returned result set; its source_ids cannot be attributed to individual queries. Historical query dates are recorded as 17 October 2026 in the phase6 search-boundary ledger. On 24 October 2026 the record was searched again in English; the result links of each query were matched against registered sources in the same way.
check.independence_note: Historical audit under the superseded two-independent-sources rule: Two substantively independent evidence origins were not established. Multiple pages from one owner, mirrors, reports of the same underlying announcement and general regional coverage are not counted as independent corroboration.

record.notes:
The Department of Public Information's 18 February 2026 report describes AI as part of a long-term strategy and discusses data-centre proposals. An unofficial claim of a 2024 national AI and digital strategy was not confirmed. A parliamentary press release on an IPU AI session returned HTTP 403.

The government describes plans to transform IAST into an innovation and AI-development hub. The proposed IAST hub also has a research remit. English-language searches for a government-designated AI safety institute with a remit to evaluate advanced models included a separate search of gov.gy.

next_check.reason: Look for a published AI or digital strategy.
